shots.visual: Extreme close-up of a face contorted in madness, eyes wide and bloodshot, screaming into a chaotic background of fire and smoke.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 既然留不住，就一起燒了！

shots.visual: Mid-shot of a figure standing on a burning ship deck, tossing a lit torch into a pile of dry wood and oil drums nearby.
Two-shot, one figure on left reacting with horror to the explosion, another figure on right rushing forward to stop them, arms outstretched.
Close-up of a woman's face, tears mixing with soot, screaming desperately while trying to pull someone back from the edge of a fire.
Mid-shot of a man in disheveled robes, laughing maniacally while holding a torch, flames reflecting in his pale, terrified yet excited eyes.
Wide shot of a battlefield, revealing a massive wall of fire cutting off all escape routes, with wooden fortifications burning intensely.
Mid-shot of a general in armor, watching the fire spread precisely, a cold, calculated smirk on his face, smoke drifting past.
Mid-shot of a counselor in robes, observing the scene with a mix of admiration and shock, nodding slowly to the general's plan.
Close-up of a hand gripping a torch, fingers trembling, flame casting harsh shadows on the ground, panic evident in the trembling.
Mid-shot of the woman physically pushing the man away from a burning grain silo, her clothes soot-stained, facial expression full of desperation.
Close-up of the man's face, twisted in rage, spitting words at the woman, background blurred with intense orange light from the fire.
Close-up of the woman's face, pleading eyes, smoke filling her nose, tears streaming down soot-covered cheeks.
Mid-shot of the man ignoring the plea, turning back to the flames, raising the torch high again with a delusional grin.
Extreme close-up of eyes widening in terror as a massive wave of heat and flame erupts beside her, hair blowing wildly in the wind.
Mid-shot of the woman being thrown backward by an explosion, hitting a wooden beam, sliding down in pain, surrounded by falling embers.
